dict.string: Caffeine Tracker reads dietary caffeine to build your milligram timeline and estimate what may remain now and at bedtime. If you turn on Body insights, it also reads sleep, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, heart rate, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, steps, active energy, workouts, body mass, age, and biological sex so it can compare your higher-caffeine days with your lower ones, show your heart rate around each drink, and suggest a starting half-life. Body insights are optional, read-only, and stay on your device.

Caffeine Tracker saves the milligrams you log to Apple Health as dietary caffeine, marked as manually entered and tagged with the drink name, so your caffeine timeline stays available to other health apps. If you decline, entries stay on this device and are retried later.
